source.interpretation: An extendable mission does not complete until its active DURN has accrued; a stop inside suspension can leave active work outstanding.

exact_delta: Control.SIMPE and Control.RCEND change from 16.0 to 12.5 hours.
Both ResultCollection.RCEND rows change from 16.0 to 12.5 hours.
ProblemDescription.PDESC changes descriptive label only; all aircraft, mission, preparation, failure/repair, seed and schedule fields stay fixed.
predeclared_native_acceptance: One immutable guarded session-0 SSH run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID 13340 identity guard, source and raw SHA-256 seals, four CLI steps and exact row-containing source roundtrip.
Conversion must have zero errors; classify warnings. Compare all pre-horizon mission and failure events to the accepted parent without assuming equality merely from the fixed seed.

If the second suspension begins before 12.5 and its replacement has not attached, require no mission completion or success before stop, a retained suspended aircraft, replacement preparation and failed-aircraft repair still unfinished, and report intervals ending at 12.5.

Reconcile observed active and suspended time from log events with report aircraft-hour integrals and terminal state; distinguish a directly reported remainder from one inferred by subtracting active time from DURN.
If the stop is not inside an observed suspension or the native report does not expose enough state, retain the run as a probe and publish only what is directly supported.
limits: One fixed seed and stochastic failure timing; the horizon was chosen from an accepted observed event and does not establish a general stopping rule.
Any remaining active duration calculated from printed event timestamps is an inference, not a native remaining-work field.
Other stop boundaries, GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
